title: Determination of the Charge the Collective Retains When a Granite Ridge Season Pass Is Given Up
content:
A household may give a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass up, and this rule fixes the charge the collective retains on the pass account when it does.

**The charge base.** The charge base is the tier's cancellation fee.

**The window share.** The charge base is taken as it stands wherever in the cancellation window the pass is given up, a share of 100 per cent.

**The outstanding share.** The figure the window share produces is taken as it stands whatever the pass account still shows to collect, a share of 100 per cent.

**The scan component.** Nothing further is retained for the lift scans the pass account shows.

**The season allowance.** No allowance is settled against the charge for the season still to come.

**Protection relief.** No relief is given for protection the household holds.

**How the figures assemble.** The charge base is taken at the window share and the figure that produces is taken at the outstanding share, each share acting on the figure the step before it produced and never on the charge base a second time; the scan component is then added to that figure, the two allowances are settled against what that gives, and the charge retained is rounded to the cent once at the end and is never below zero.

### The determination worked through

Hypothetical inputs: a Granite Ridge Summit Pass given up, that tier's cancellation fee being 125.00.

The charge base is 125.00. The window share takes it as it stands, leaving 125.00. The outstanding share acts on the figure the window share produced and takes it as it stands, leaving 125.00. Nothing further is retained for the lift scans the pass account shows, so nothing is added. No allowance is settled against the figure and no relief is given, so nothing is taken off. Rounded to the cent once at the end, the charge retained on the pass account is 125.00.

The two shares act one after the other: the outstanding share is taken on what the window share produced, and neither is taken on the charge base a second time.
